name: @ag-bash/bash
description: AI-native bash interpreter in TypeScript — a sandboxed, in-process POSIX shell engine for AI agents, with 110+ builtins, WASM Python/JS/SQLite runtimes, fork-speculation, an MCP server, and an agent terminal bridge.
author: Ag-Bash

scripts.build: echo 'Build started' && rm -rf dist && tsc && mkdir -p dist/parser/vendor && cp src/parser/vendor/* dist/parser/vendor/ && mkdir -p dist/commands/ag-convert && cp src/commands/ag-convert/*.py dist/commands/ag-convert/ && pnpm build:lib && pnpm build:lib:cjs && pnpm build:subpaths:cjs && pnpm build:browser && pnpm build:browser-core && pnpm build:cli && pnpm build:shell && pnpm build:worker && mkdir -p dist/bundle/chunks && cp src/parser/vendor/*.wasm dist/bundle/ && cp src/parser/vendor/*.wasm dist/bundle/chunks/ && pnpm build:clean && node scripts/make-root-dcts.cjs dist/index.d.ts dist/index.d.cts && cp dist/advanced.d.ts dist/advanced.d.cts && cp dist/testing.d.ts dist/testing.d.cts && cp dist/ai/index.d.ts dist/ai/index.d.cts && cp dist/agent-runtime/index.d.ts dist/agent-runtime/index.d.cts && sed '1,/^-->/d' AGENTS.npm.md > dist/AGENTS.md && chmod +x dist/bin/ag-bash.js dist/bin/shell/shell.js
scripts.build:worker: esbuild src/commands/python3/worker.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/commands/python3/worker.js --external:../../../vendor/cpython-emscripten/* && mkdir -p dist/bin/chunks && cp dist/commands/python3/worker.js dist/bin/chunks/python-worker.js && mkdir -p dist/bundle/chunks && cp dist/commands/python3/worker.js dist/bundle/chunks/python-worker.js && esbuild src/commands/js-exec/worker.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/commands/js-exec/worker.js --external:quickjs-emscripten && cp dist/commands/js-exec/worker.js dist/bin/chunks/js-worker.js && cp dist/commands/js-exec/worker.js dist/bundle/chunks/js-worker.js && esbuild src/commands/sqlite3/worker.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/commands/sqlite3/worker.js --external:sql.js && cp dist/commands/sqlite3/worker.js dist/bin/chunks/sqlite-worker.js && cp dist/commands/sqlite3/worker.js dist/bundle/chunks/sqlite-worker.js
scripts.build:subpaths:cjs: esbuild dist/advanced.js --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --minify --outfile=dist/advanced.cjs --define:import.meta.url='""' --external:diff --external:minimatch --external:sprintf-js --external:turndown --external:sql.js --external:quickjs-emscripten --external:@mongodb-js/zstd --external:node-liblzma --external:seek-bzip --log-override:empty-import-meta=silent --log-override:direct-eval=silent && esbuild dist/testing.js --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --minify --outfile=dist/testing.cjs --define:import.meta.url='""' --external:diff --external:minimatch --external:sprintf-js --external:turndown --external:sql.js --external:quickjs-emscripten --external:@mongodb-js/zstd --external:node-liblzma --external:seek-bzip --log-override:empty-import-meta=silent --log-override:direct-eval=silent && esbuild dist/ai.js --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --minify --outfile=dist/ai.cjs --define:import.meta.url='""' --external:diff --external:minimatch --external:sprintf-js --external:turndown --external:sql.js --external:quickjs-emscripten --external:@mongodb-js/zstd --external:node-liblzma --external:seek-bzip --log-override:empty-import-meta=silent --log-override:direct-eval=silent && esbuild dist/agent-runtime/index.js --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --minify --outfile=dist/agent-runtime/index.cjs --define:import.meta.url='""' --external:diff --external:minimatch --external:sprintf-js --external:turndown --external:sql.js --external:quickjs-emscripten --external:@mongodb-js/zstd --external:node-liblzma --external:seek-bzip --log-override:empty-import-meta=silent --log-override:direct-eval=silent
scripts.prepublish:ci: pnpm lint && pnpm knip && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm check:worker-sync
scripts.validate: pnpm lint && pnpm knip && pnpm typecheck &&  pnpm build && pnpm check:worker-sync && pnpm test:run && pnpm test:wasm && pnpm test:dist
scripts.test:run: vitest run --testTimeout=20000 --hookTimeout=20000 --maxWorkers=8 --exclude src/security/fuzzing/ --exclude src/commands/python3/ --exclude src/commands/sqlite3/ --exclude src/commands/js-exec/ --exclude src/agent-examples/python-scripting.test.ts --exclude 'src/comparison-tests/**' --exclude '**/*.comparison.test.ts' --exclude src/cli/ag-bash.v-next.e2e.test.ts --exclude 'src/security/attacks/**' --exclude src/security/wasm-callback.test.ts --exclude src/security/sandbox/python-sqlite-information-disclosure.test.ts --exclude src/security/sandbox/error-forwarding-runtime-leak-probe.test.ts --exclude src/security/sandbox/worker-protocol-runtime-desync.test.ts --exclude src/security/defense-in-depth-box.test.ts --exclude src/security/defense-in-depth-box-concurrent.test.ts --exclude src/security/worker-defense-in-depth.test.ts --exclude '**/*.bundle.test.ts' --exclude src/cli/ag-bash.test.ts --exclude 'src/spec-tests/**' --exclude 'src/network/**' --exclude src/commands/curl/tests/allowlist.test.ts --exclude src/readme.test.ts --exclude 'src/commands/ag-convert/**'
scripts.test:slow: pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:comparison && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.test:integration: vitest run --testTimeout=120000 --hookTimeout=120000 src/spec-tests/ src/network/ src/commands/curl/tests/allowlist.test.ts src/readme.test.ts src/commands/ag-convert/
scripts.bench:ci:multi: vitest bench --run --config vitest.bench.config.ts --outputJson bench-results.1.json && vitest bench --run --config vitest.bench.config.ts --outputJson bench-results.2.json && vitest bench --run --config vitest.bench.config.ts --outputJson bench-results.3.json
scripts.bench:check: pnpm bench:ci:multi && node scripts/bench-check.js --current bench-results.1.json --current bench-results.2.json --current bench-results.3.json
scripts.bench:update: pnpm bench:ci:multi && node scripts/bench-check.js --update --current bench-results.1.json --current bench-results.2.json --current bench-results.3.json
